proposal.name: Place a new repository's first project

plan.name: Place a new repository's first project
plan.summary: `Clone.Dirs` in internal/factory/repo.go returns no directories, and no error, when the directory it lists isn't there at a ref that exists. So when the base branch has no projects directory yet, as in a new repository, `projectDir` places the first ratified project at `<dir>/01-<slug>` instead of failing on every poll. A ref that doesn't exist, a path that's a file, and any other failure to list the directory are still errors. Errors like these still show only in the watcher's log, as now; saying them on the issue isn't part of this change. This changes the trusted base, so a person merges it.

tests.name: TestTheFirstProjectGoesInANewProjectsDirectory
tests.says: With a base branch that has no projects directory, ratifying a proposal places its project at <dir>/01-<slug>, here invariant/01-bounded-buffer, and the issue's branch holds its ratified lock there.

tests.name: TestDirsOfADirectoryThatIsntThereAreNone
tests.says: Listing a directory that isn't there, at a ref that exists, gives no directories and no error; a directory that's there still lists its subdirectories; and a ref that doesn't exist, or a path that's a file, is still an error.

usage.summary: I've written the plan and it passed the check on the first try: both acceptance tests fail on the code as it is. The build may change only `internal/factory/repo.go`, where `Clone.Dirs` will list no directories and return no error when the projects directory isn't on the base branch, so a new repository's first ratified project goes to `<dir>/01-<slug>`. A branch that doesn't exist, a path that's a file, or any other failure to list the directory is still an error, and the plan says the ratifier still won't see errors on the issue; they go only to the watcher's log, as before.
